title: runtime/policies.json — fully-resolved policy tables (ADR-005 Part 2, ADR-003 §8)
description: Compiled, flat, complete. The tighten-only merge algebra runs in the compiler (stage 5); a runtime never merges policy. Matrix completeness over the intent set is proved at compile time, not by this schema.

confirmation.description: intent id → confirmation policy. High-cost actions must resolve to 'always' (medical wrong-action budget).

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\\.[a-.description: always = the intent declares a followup and confirms on every turn; never = it fires directly. There is deliberately no confidence-conditional value: a band that decides when to ask was removed in favour of a single fire threshold (docs/confirm-gate-diagnosis.md), and an app contract cannot depend on where the classifier happened to land.

agreement.description: Relaxed bar applied when two INDEPENDENT recognisers name the same intent — a keyword rule and the model, or the model and the semantic head. Corroboration offsets the softmax diffusion of a large label space, so a turn both stages agree on need only clear this instead of `confidence`. It is evidence strength, not a confidence: the reported confidence stays the model's calibrated probability.
